newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-DALIAN BEATS SHANGHAI FOR 45TH VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DALIAN BEATS SHANGHAI FOR 45TH VICTORY.

text.p: China's Dalian Wanda defeated Shanghai Shenhua 1-0 at home on Thursday to give the team a record 45 successive unbeaten matches in the China soccer league, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Hao Haidong, who transferred from the army's August First team at the start of this season for a record fee of 2.2 million yuan ($250,000), scored the only goal in the 24th minute, Xinhua said.
Shanghai Shenhua, who went down to a nightmare 1-9 defeat to Beijing Guo'an on Sunday, put more pressure on Dalian Wanda's defences in the second half but failed to score.

In the day's other matches, Sichuan Quanxing trounced Guangzhou Apollo 3-0, Tianjin Samsung defeated Jinan Taishan 2-1, August First edged Vanguard Huandao 2-1 and Yanbian Aodong drew 2-2 with Beijing Guo'an.
